questions.question: A map of a city is drawn on a scale of 1 : 150000. The distance between two cities, A and B, on this map is 6 cm. What will be the actual distance between the two cities?
questions.solution:
**Given**

1 ∶ 150000

**Concept**

Direct variation

If the one quantity(say x) increase or decrease, the other quantity(say y) also increases or decrease to the same extent. then the variation is known as direct variation.

so, If x₁ and x₂ are the values of x quantity and y₁ and y₂ are the values of y quantity, then

x₁y₂ = y₁x₂

**Calculation**

x₁ = 1, y₁ = 150000, x₂ = 6 and y₂ = y₂

⇒ x₁ × y₂ = 150000 × 6

⇒ 1 × y₂ = 9,00,000

⇒ y₂ = 9,00,000

1 km = 1,00,000 cm

so,y₂ = 9 Km

**∴ The actual distance between the two cities is 9 km.**

questions.question: In how many years will a sum of Rs. 1,600 amount to Rs. 2,116 at 15% compound interest?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Amount** to **Principal** = 2116 : 1600 = 529 : 400.

Rate of 15% means the **multiplication factor** per year is 115/100 = 23/20.

Observe the relationship: (23/20)² = 529/400.

The exponent (power) directly represents the number of **years**.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹1600

**Amount (A)** = ₹2116

**Rate (R)** = 15% per annum

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, where n = time in **years**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/111145b51c1858e38c5033d2bfd6ae2094761ad58b8c9e9e20f65eb65c7ad865.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2116 = 1600(1 + 15/100)ⁿ

⇒ 2116 / 1600 = (115/100)ⁿ

⇒ 529 / 400 = (23 / 20)ⁿ

⇒ (23 / 20)² = (23 / 20)ⁿ

⇒ n = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Formula

Amount (A) = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ, where **CI = A − P**. Interest is calculated on the accumulated principal of previous years.

Difference between CI and SI

For a period of **2 years**, the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest is given by **P(R/100)²**.

Effective Rate of Interest

For two successive years at R%, the effective compound interest rate is **R + R + (R×R)/100**.

questions.question: Which constitutional amendment gave the Directive Principles precedence over Fundamental Rights?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**42nd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Articles 39A, 43A, and 48A of the 42nd Amendment** were inserted as additional Directive Principles.
 
• By saying that "no law embodying any of the Directive Principles may be deemed unconstitutional on the grounds that it infringed any of the Fundamental Rights," the 42nd Amendment accorded the Directive Principles precedence.
 
• Laws forbidding "anti-national actions" or the establishment of "anti-national organisations" could not be declared unlawful because they infringed on any of the Fundamental Rights, according to the Amendment.
 
• The 42nd Amendment's provision that Directive Principles take precedence over Fundamental Rights was abolished by the 43rd and 44th Amendments, which also limited Parliament's ability to legislate against "anti-national actions."
 
• The 42nd Amendment also included a new section to the Constitution's Article on **"Fundamental Duties."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Arunachal Pradesh was granted statehood via the** 55th Amendment, **making it the Indian Union's 24th state.

questions.question: The average weight of an apple in a sample of 10 apples was calculated as 104 g. Later on, it was found that the weighing had shown the weight of each apple 20 g less. The correct average weight of an apple in that sample is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If each value in a data set is increased by a constant amount, the **average** of the set increases by that same amount.

Since each of the **10 apples** was **20 g** lighter than its actual weight, the **average** is also **20 g** less than the actual average.

Correct Average = Recorded Average + Error per apple

Correct Average = 104 + 20 = 124 g

**∴ The correct answer is 124 g.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of apples = 10

Observed average weight = 104 g

Weight error per apple = −20 g (under-weighed)

**Formula Used:**

Total Weight = Average Weight × Number of items

Correct Average = Correct Total Weight ÷ Number of items

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/935bffc6a146b09c4ec63d40420d091cd4408583bc67be8f20c461daa313a85f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total observed weight of 10 apples = 104 × 10 = 1040 g

⇒ Total weight error = 20 × 10 = 200 g

⇒ Actual total weight = 1040 + 200 = 1240 g

⇒ Actual average weight = 1240 ÷ 10 = 124 g

**∴ The correct answer is 124 g.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effect of Arithmetic Operations on Average

If every observation in a data set is increased, decreased, multiplied, or divided by a constant **k**, the **mean (average)** of the data set also increases, decreases, is multiplied, or divided by **k** respectively.

Correcting the Average Formula

Correct Average = [ (Observed Average × n) + (Actual value − Wrong value) ] ÷ n. This formula is useful when specific values are misread or miscalculated.

Sum of Observations

The sum of **n** observations is equal to the product of the **average** and the number of observations (**Sum = Average × n**).</p

work done = Efficiency × time

⇒ 7 - 5

⇒ 30 hours

questions.question: A and B can finish a work in 9 days, B and C can finish it in 12 days and A and C can finish it in 18 days. In how many days can A, B and C finish the work together?
questions.solution:
**Given**

A and B finish a work in 9 days

B and C finish a work in 12 days

A and C finish a work in 18 days

**Concept**

Find the efficiency. Means first find the work done by person in one day. then, reciprocate the answer to find the number of days, in which the work will be complete.

**Calculation**

Work done by A and B in one day(A + B) = (1/9) ---- (1)

work done by B and C in one day(B + C) = 1/12 ---- (2)

work done by A and C in one day(C + A) = 1/18 ---- (3)

Adding (1), (2) and (3)

⇒ A + B + B + C + C + A = (1/9) + (1/12) + (1/18)

⇒ 2A + 2B + 2C = (4 + 3 + 2)/36

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 9/36

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 1/4

⇒ A + B + C = 1/8

1/8th work is done by A, B and C in one day. so, Total work done by A, B and C in 8 days.

**∴ A, B and C finish the work together in 8 days.**
